title: Cash Hub Home
subtitle: The landing dashboard for the cash and statements workflow
what_it_is:
The first screen a Cash Hub user sees after signing in. It anchors the rest of the application — the AppBar across the top, the navigation drawer collapsed on the left, and the body where every other screen renders. Most customers will reach this screen first; what they see here sets the tone for the whole product.

This is also where role-based navigation is enforced: the drawer items that show up here depend on the signed-in user's role and hierarchy assignment. Two users on the same brokerage's instance can have entirely different drawer contents.
what_you_see: **OneDigital logo + Cash hub title** in the top-left of the AppBar (placeholder until HSO productization is locked).
**Drawer toggle** (the 3-bar icon) to expand or collapse the navigation pane.
**Notifications bell**, **settings gear**, and **user menu** on the right of the AppBar.
**Drawer categories** (visible when expanded): Overview, Statements, Templates, Cash, Cash Application, Accruals — each gated by user permissions.
data_sources: **No data query runs on this screen** — it's pure navigation. The drawer items are built from the user's permission set returned by `IUserSecurityPermissionViewService`.
**Hierarchy filtering** (Region / Market / PnL / CostCenter) is evaluated by `PermissionHandler` to decide which drawer entries to render.
workflow_context:
Cash Hub is one of three internal Blazor apps in ERP Unite. Cash Hub owns the statement-to-cash and accruals-to-GL workflows; Compensation Hub owns the producer compensation side; Producer Portal is the external-facing surface. They share the same underlying database and a common Microsoft Entra ID sign-on.

The Home screen exists primarily to validate sign-on and route the user to their actual work. Most users will navigate immediately to Statements, Cash Applications, or Accrual Batches from here.

vocabulary.definition: The bar across the top of the screen that holds the logo, app title, and the notification/settings/user menus.
The collapsible left-side navigation pane. Items shown depend on user permissions and hierarchy scope.
The combination of Region / Market / P&L / Cost Center attached to a UserRole that scopes what the user can see.

questions.q: Why does my user see different drawer items than someone else?
questions.a: Drawer items are permission-gated. Each user's UserRole carries a set of permissions (and optionally a regional or hierarchy scope). The drawer only renders items the user has access to.

questions.q: Can we put a customer logo here instead of OneDigital?
questions.a: Yes — the logo is in `Unite.Shared.UI/wwwroot/`. Productization Phase 3 swaps it. Until then, it shows the OneDigital placeholder.
